```{r settings, include = FALSE}
# Same rules as 07 so the numbers match
MIN_GROUP_N <- 5     # a comparison is tested only when every group has at least this many people
CALMER_CUT  <- 5     # a drop of at least this many negative-affect points counts as "calmer"

# Healogix chart colors: as blue as possible; the negative end of a scale may be non-blue
DARK <- "#0b3d68"; LIGHT <- "#29abe2"; PALE <- "#9DC3E6"; MID <- "#4A86C5"
NEG  <- "#E3A26F"; BAR  <- "#BDBDBD"; GRID <- "#E6E9EE"; INK <- "#1c2430"; MUTED <- "#5f6b7a"

PA_ITEMS <- c("interested", "excited", "strong", "enthusiastic", "proud",
              "alert", "inspired", "determined", "attentive", "active")
NA_ITEMS <- c("distressed", "upset", "guilty", "scared", "hostile",
              "irritable", "ashamed", "nervous", "jittery", "afraid")
```

```{r load-and-score, include = FALSE}
# ---- Participant IDs (same approach as the 07 report) ----
# The survey file may carry response_id and/or prolific_id but no pid. Each file gets all three IDs,
# matched in memory from the pid-to-Prolific link file and the 00 renamed file. Nothing with IDs is written out.
ID_COLS <- c("pid", "response_id", "prolific_id")
clean_ids <- function(d) {
  names(d) <- trimws(gsub("^\ufeff", "", names(d)))   # removes a byte-order mark if the CSV has one
  low <- tolower(names(d))
  rename_first <- function(d, idx, new) { if (length(idx) && !(new %in% names(d))) names(d)[idx[1]] <- new; d }
  d <- rename_first(d, which(low == "pid"), "pid")
  d <- rename_first(d, which(low %in% c("response_id", "response id", "responseid")), "response_id")
  d <- rename_first(d, which(low %in% c("prolific_id", "prolific_pid", "prolificid", "url variable: prolific_pid")), "prolific_id")
  d |> mutate(across(any_of(ID_COLS), \(x) trimws(as.character(x))))
}
read_chr <- function(f) read_csv(f, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), na = c("", "NA")) |> clean_ids()

# Crosswalk: pid <-> prolific_id from the link file, then response_id matched on prolific_id from the 00 renamed file
ids <- if (file.exists(in_link)) read_chr(in_link) |> select(any_of(ID_COLS)) |> distinct() else tibble(pid = character())
for (col in ID_COLS) if (!col %in% names(ids)) ids[[col]] <- NA_character_
if (file.exists(in_ids)) {
  rn <- read_chr(in_ids) |> select(any_of(c("response_id", "prolific_id")))
  if (all(c("response_id", "prolific_id") %in% names(rn))) {
    rn <- rn |> filter(!is.na(prolific_id), !duplicated(prolific_id))
    ids$response_id <- coalesce(ids$response_id, rn$response_id[match(ids$prolific_id, rn$prolific_id)])
  }
}
ids <- ids |> select(all_of(ID_COLS))

# Fill whichever IDs a data frame is missing from the one(s) it has
add_ids <- function(d, label) {
  d <- clean_ids(d)
  for (col in ID_COLS) if (!col %in% names(d)) d[[col]] <- NA_character_
  for (key in ID_COLS) {
    lk <- ids[!is.na(ids[[key]]) & !duplicated(ids[[key]]), ]
    m <- match(d[[key]], lk[[key]])
    for (other in setdiff(ID_COLS, key)) d[[other]] <- coalesce(d[[other]], lk[[other]][m])
  }
  if (all(is.na(d$pid))) stop("Could not find or match a pid for ", label, ". It needs a pid, response_id or prolific_id column, ",
                              "and the link files must exist: ", basename(in_link), " and ", basename(in_ids), ".")
  ID_MATCH[[label]] <<- c(rows = nrow(d), with_pid = sum(!is.na(d$pid)))
  d |> filter(!is.na(pid)) |> relocate(all_of(ID_COLS))
}
ID_MATCH <- list()
d05   <- read_chr(in_05) |> add_ids("the survey file (05)")
codes <- read_chr(in_codes) |> add_ids("the codes file")
id_note <- paste0("ID matching: ", paste(vapply(names(ID_MATCH), \(k) paste0(k, " ", ID_MATCH[[k]]["with_pid"], " of ",
                  ID_MATCH[[k]]["rows"], " rows matched to a pid"), character(1)), collapse = "; "), ".")

CODE_BIN <- c("convo_usable", "human_mentions_disease", "human_shares_personal", "human_asks_med", "human_multi_turn",
              "human_1_long", "ai_multi_med", "ai_recommends_med", "ai_refers_professional", "ai_urgent_care",
              "ai_followup_question", "ai_disclaimer")
CODE_NUM <- c("ai_n_meds", "human_1_n_words_coded", "n_human_turns", "ai_total_words")
codes <- codes |> mutate(across(any_of(c(CODE_BIN, CODE_NUM)), as.numeric))

# PANAS answers may export as numbers or as labels; both become 1-5
PANAS_LABELS <- c("very slightly or not at all" = 1, "a little" = 2, "moderately" = 3, "quite a bit" = 4, "extremely" = 5)
to_panas <- function(x) {
  t <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(t, "^[1-5](?![0-9])")))
  ifelse(!is.na(num), num, unname(PANAS_LABELS[t]))
}
# Items 1-5 were exported twice; use the main copy and fill any gaps from the *_dup copy
panas <- d05 |> select(pid)
for (wave in c("pre", "post")) for (item in c(PA_ITEMS, NA_ITEMS)) {
  main <- paste0("panas_", wave, "_", item); dup <- paste0(main, "_dup")
  v <- to_panas(d05[[main]])
  if (dup %in% names(d05)) v <- coalesce(v, to_panas(d05[[dup]]))
  panas[[main]] <- v
}
score <- function(wave, items) {
  m <- as.matrix(panas[paste0("panas_", wave, "_", items)])
  ifelse(rowSums(is.na(m)) == 0, rowSums(m), NA_real_)   # complete answers only
}
panas <- panas |> mutate(pa_pre = score("pre", PA_ITEMS), pa_post = score("post", PA_ITEMS),
                         na_pre = score("pre", NA_ITEMS), na_post = score("post", NA_ITEMS))

SURVEY_COLS <- c("detail_topic", "detail_duration_self", "detail_duration_other", "detail_prior_knowledge",
                 "detail_chatbot", "action_ai_rec_self", "action_ai_rec_other")
dat <- codes |>
  select(pid, any_of(c(CODE_BIN, CODE_NUM)), any_of("human_first_intent")) |>
  left_join(d05 |> select(pid, any_of(SURVEY_COLS)), by = "pid") |>
  left_join(panas |> select(pid, pa_pre, pa_post, na_pre, na_post), by = "pid") |>
  mutate(na_change = na_post - na_pre, pa_change = pa_post - pa_pre)
for (col in SURVEY_COLS) if (!col %in% names(dat)) dat[[col]] <- NA_character_
```

```{r segments, include = FALSE}
# The same 16 segments as 07. All 16 are needed so the Benjamini-Hochberg correction matches 07 exactly.
lc <- function(x) trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
bin_lab <- function(x, lab1, lab0) factor(ifelse(x == 1, lab1, ifelse(x == 0, lab0, NA)), levels = c(lab1, lab0))
recode_intent <- function(x) factor(case_when(
  x == "symptom_interpretation" ~ "Symptom interpretation",
  x == "self_management" ~ "Self-management",
  x %in% c("condition_info", "medication_info", "care_decision", "other") ~ "Other questions",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("Symptom interpretation", "Self-management", "Other questions"))
recode_topic <- function(x) { t <- lc(x); factor(case_when(
  t == "3" | str_detect(t, "specific diagnosed") ~ "Diagnosed condition",
  t == "2" | str_detect(t, "not been diagnosed|symptom") ~ "Undiagnosed symptom",
  t %in% c("1", "4") | str_detect(t, "general health|wellness|medication or treatment") ~ "General wellness or medication",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("Diagnosed condition", "Undiagnosed symptom", "General wellness or medication")) }
recode_duration <- function(x) { t <- lc(x); factor(case_when(
  t %in% c("1", "2") | str_detect(t, "less than a week|1 to 4 weeks") ~ "Under a month",
  t %in% c("3", "4", "5", "6") | str_detect(t, "month|year") ~ "A month or longer",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("Under a month", "A month or longer")) }
recode_prior <- function(x) { t <- lc(x); factor(case_when(
  t %in% c("1", "2") | str_detect(t, "nothing at all|^a little") ~ "Nothing or a little",
  t %in% c("3", "4", "5") | str_detect(t, "moderate|a lot|great deal") ~ "Moderate or more",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("Nothing or a little", "Moderate or more")) }
recode_chatbot <- function(x) { t <- lc(x); factor(case_when(
  t == "1" | str_detect(t, "chatgpt") ~ "ChatGPT",
  t == "99" | str_detect(t, "remember") ~ NA_character_,
  !is.na(t) & t != "" ~ "Other chatbot",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("ChatGPT", "Other chatbot")) }
intent_col <- if ("human_first_intent" %in% names(dat)) dat$human_first_intent else rep(NA_character_, nrow(dat))

SEGMENTS <- list(
  "Named a disease"             = bin_lab(dat$human_mentions_disease, "Named a disease", "No disease named"),
  "Shared personal details"     = bin_lab(dat$human_shares_personal, "Shared personal details", "General questions only"),
  "Asked about a medication"    = bin_lab(dat$human_asks_med, "Asked about a medication", "Did not ask about one"),
  "First message intent"        = recode_intent(intent_col),
  "Number of turns"             = bin_lab(dat$human_multi_turn, "More than one turn", "One turn"),
  "First message length"        = bin_lab(dat$human_1_long, "Longer first message", "Shorter first message"),
  "AI medications"              = bin_lab(dat$ai_multi_med, "AI named 2+ medications", "AI named one medication"),
  "AI recommended a medication" = bin_lab(dat$ai_recommends_med, "AI recommended a medication", "Did not recommend one"),
  "Referred to a professional"  = bin_lab(dat$ai_refers_professional, "Referred to a professional", "No referral"),
  "Urgent care advice"          = bin_lab(dat$ai_urgent_care, "Mentioned urgent or emergency care", "Did not"),
  "Asked a follow-up question"  = bin_lab(dat$ai_followup_question, "AI asked a follow-up question", "No follow-up question"),
  "Included a disclaimer"       = bin_lab(dat$ai_disclaimer, "Included a disclaimer", "No disclaimer"),
  "Topic"                       = recode_topic(dat$detail_topic),
  "Condition duration"          = recode_duration(coalesce(dat$detail_duration_self, dat$detail_duration_other)),
  "Prior knowledge"             = recode_prior(dat$detail_prior_knowledge),
  "Chatbot"                     = recode_chatbot(dat$detail_chatbot))

CALMER <- factor(case_when(dat$na_change <= -CALMER_CUT ~ "Calmer",
                           dat$na_change >= CALMER_CUT ~ "More distressed",
                           !is.na(dat$na_change) ~ "About the same"),
                 levels = c("Calmer", "About the same", "More distressed"))
```

```{r stats, include = FALSE}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
safe <- function(expr) tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) NULL)
fmt  <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d))
fmts <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", sprintf(paste0("%+.", d, "f"), x))
fmtp <- function(p, d = 3) ifelse(is.na(p), "NA", ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", sub("^0", "", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = d))))

# Negative-affect change by group: Mann-Whitney (2 groups) or Kruskal-Wallis (3), as in 07
na_test <- function(group) {
  d <- tibble(group = group, change = dat$na_change) |> filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(change)) |> mutate(group = droplevels(group))
  n <- table(d$group); if (length(n) < 2 || any(n < MIN_GROUP_N)) return(NA_real_)
  if (length(n) == 2) safe(wilcox.test(change ~ group, data = d, exact = FALSE)$p.value) %||% NA_real_
  else safe(kruskal.test(change ~ group, data = d)$p.value) %||% NA_real_
}
# Felt calmer (yes / no) by group: Fisher's exact, as in 07
calmer_test <- function(group) {
  d <- tibble(group = group, cat = CALMER) |> filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(cat)) |> mutate(group = droplevels(group), cat = droplevels(cat))
  n <- table(d$group); if (length(n) < 2 || any(n < MIN_GROUP_N) || nlevels(d$cat) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  tab <- table(d$group, d$cat == "Calmer"); if (ncol(tab) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  safe(fisher.test(tab)$p.value) %||% NA_real_
}
bh <- function(p) { out <- rep(NA_real_, length(p)); ok <- !is.na(p); out[ok] <- p.adjust(p[ok], "BH"); setNames(out, names(p)) }

P_NA     <- vapply(SEGMENTS, na_test, numeric(1));     P_NA_BH     <- bh(P_NA)
P_CALMER <- vapply(SEGMENTS, calmer_test, numeric(1)); P_CALMER_BH <- bh(P_CALMER)

# ---- Shared chart theme: title states the result, subtitle gives the data details ----
theme_hx <- function() theme_minimal(base_size = 15) + theme(
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = INK, size = 18, margin = margin(b = 6)),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(color = MUTED, size = 12, margin = margin(b = 14)),
  plot.caption = element_text(color = MUTED, size = 10, hjust = 0),
  plot.title.position = "plot", plot.caption.position = "plot",
  axis.text = element_text(color = INK), axis.title = element_text(color = INK, size = 12),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_line(color = GRID),
  legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left", legend.title = element_blank(),
  plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), plot.margin = margin(20, 24, 16, 20))
save_fig <- function(p, name, w = 10, h = 8) { ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, bg = "white"); p }
wrap <- function(x, n = 70) paste(strwrap(x, n), collapse = "\n")

# ---- Collects every number shown in the deck, next to what R gets now ----
CHECK <- list()
check <- function(slide, measure, deck, r) CHECK[[length(CHECK) + 1]] <<- tibble(Slide = slide, Measure = measure, Deck = deck, R = r)
```

```{r hover-helpers, include = FALSE}
# ---- Interactive charts: hover over a bar, dot or square to see the numbers and example messages ----
# The examples are real conversation excerpts, so this report is for internal use only (keep it out of the public repo).
HOVER_EXAMPLES <- 3      # examples shown per bar or group
HOVER_CHARS    <- 180    # characters kept from each example
PLOT_W         <- 900    # chart width in pixels (fixed, so charts in hidden tabs draw at full size)
set.seed(2026)           # the same examples every time you knit; change the number to see others

TXT <- codes |> select(pid, matches("^(human|ai)_[0-9]+$"))
turns_of <- function(id, who) {
  r <- TXT[TXT$pid == id, , drop = FALSE]; if (!nrow(r)) return(character(0))
  cols <- grep(paste0("^", who, "_[0-9]+$"), names(r), value = TRUE)
  cols <- cols[order(as.integer(sub(".*_", "", cols)))]
  v <- as.character(unlist(r[1, cols], use.names = FALSE)); v[!is.na(v) & nzchar(trimws(v))]
}
clip <- function(x, n = HOVER_CHARS) { x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(x)); ifelse(nchar(x) > n, paste0(substr(x, 1, n - 3), "..."), x) }
wrap_html <- function(x, w = 60) vapply(x, function(s) paste(strwrap(htmltools::htmlEscape(s), w), collapse = "<br>"), character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)

# Words that point to the passage behind each code. Used only to pick which sentence or message to show.
PAT <- list(
  human_asks_cause          = "why|what (is|could|might|would)|caus|normal|serious|worr|concern|is (this|it|that) ",
  human_asks_treatment      = "what (can|should) i (do|take|eat|use)|how (do|can|should) i|treat|reliev|help (with|my)|get rid|remed|manage",
  human_asks_condition_info = "what (is|are) |does .* (grow|spread|go away|last)|how long|tell me about|explain",
  human_asks_care           = "doctor|\\bdr\\b|see (a|someone|my)|urgent|\\ber\\b|emergency|specialist|appointment|clinic|test|surgery",
  human_asks_med            = "medic|\\bpills?\\b|dose|dosage|\\bmg\\b|ibuprofen|tylenol|advil|acetaminophen|antibiotic|prescri|zepbound|ozempic|semaglutide|tirzepatide",
  human_pushback            = "\\bno\\b|\\bbut\\b|actually|still|wrong|didn'?t|not what|that'?s not|are you sure",
  human_followup_new_question = "\\?",
  ai_refers_professional    = "doctor|physician|provider|healthcare professional|pharmacist|dermatologist|specialist|clinician|get (it |this )?(checked|evaluated|looked at)|appointment",
  ai_urgent_care            = "emergency|urgent care|\\ber\\b|911|immediate|right away|seek (medical )?(help|care|attention)",
  ai_followup_question      = "\\?\\s*$",
  ai_disclaimer             = "not a (doctor|substitute|medical professional)|not medical advice|informational purposes|cannot (diagnose|give medical)|not able to diagnose")
med_pattern <- function(id) {
  m <- codes$ai_meds_named[codes$pid == id]; m <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(ifelse(is.na(m[1]), "", m[1]), ";")))
  m <- m[nzchar(m)]; generic <- if (length(m)) paste(str_replace_all(m, "([.()+])", "\\\\\\1"), collapse = "|") else NULL
  paste(c(generic, PAT$human_asks_med), collapse = "|")
}

# A participant message: the first one (from message `from` on) that matches `pattern`, else the first one
pick_human <- function(id, pattern = NULL, from = 1) {
  m <- turns_of(id, "human"); if (length(m) < from) return(NA_character_); m <- m[from:length(m)]
  if (!is.null(pattern)) { k <- which(str_detect(tolower(m), pattern)); if (length(k)) return(m[k[1]]) }
  m[1]
}
# An AI sentence that matches `pattern` (the passage behind an AI code), else the AI's first sentence
pick_ai <- function(id, pattern = NULL) {
  s <- unlist(str_split(paste(turns_of(id, "ai"), collapse = " "), "(?<=[.!?])\\s+"))
  s <- s[nchar(trimws(s)) > 15]; if (!length(s)) return(NA_character_)
  if (!is.null(pattern)) { k <- which(str_detect(tolower(s), pattern)); if (length(k)) return(s[k[1]]) }
  s[1]
}
first_msg <- function(id) pick_human(id)
last_msg  <- function(id) { m <- turns_of(id, "human"); if (length(m) > 1) m[length(m)] else NA_character_ }
ask_msg   <- function(code) function(id) pick_human(id, PAT[[code]])
later_msg <- function(code = NULL) function(id) pick_human(id, if (is.null(code)) NULL else PAT[[code]], from = 2)
ai_msg    <- function(code = NULL) function(id) pick_ai(id, if (is.null(code)) NULL else
  if (code %in% c("ai_named_med", "ai_recommends_med")) med_pattern(id) else PAT[[code]])

# Up to HOVER_EXAMPLES people from `ids`; for each, one line per entry in `funs` (for example Participant and AI)
examples <- function(ids, funs, label = "Examples from the conversations") {
  ids <- unique(ids[!is.na(ids)]); if (!length(ids)) return("")
  ids <- if (length(ids) > HOVER_EXAMPLES) sample(ids, HOVER_EXAMPLES) else ids
  one <- function(i) {
    parts <- vapply(names(funs), function(nm) { t <- funs[[nm]](i)
      if (is.na(t) || !nzchar(t)) "" else paste0("<i>", nm, ":</i> ", wrap_html(clip(t))) }, character(1))
    parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]; if (!length(parts)) "" else paste0("<b>pid ", i, "</b><br>", paste(parts, collapse = "<br>"))
  }
  txt <- vapply(ids, one, character(1)); txt <- txt[nzchar(txt)]; if (!length(txt)) return("")
  paste0("<br><br><b>", label, "</b><br>", paste(txt, collapse = "<br><br>"))
}
ids_where <- function(d, cond) d$pid[!is.na(cond) & cond]
hover_share <- function(label, pct, n, N, ex) paste0("<b>", htmltools::htmlEscape(label), "</b><br>", round(pct), "% (", n, " of ", N, ")", ex)

# ---- plotly versions of the deck charts ----
ttl <- function(p) gsub("\n", " ", p$labels$title)
sub_of <- function(p) gsub("\n", " ", p$labels$subtitle %||% "")
pl_layout <- function(pl, p, ...) pl |> layout(
  title = list(text = paste0("<b>", paste(strwrap(htmltools::htmlEscape(ttl(p)), 85), collapse = "<br>"), "</b><br><span style='font-size:12px;color:", MUTED, "'>",
                             paste(strwrap(htmltools::htmlEscape(sub_of(p)), 125), collapse = "<br>"), "</span>"),
               x = 0, xanchor = "left", font = list(size = 16, color = INK)),
  margin = list(t = 120, l = 10, r = 30, b = 90), font = list(family = "Arial", color = INK),
  hoverlabel = list(align = "left", bgcolor = "white", bordercolor = GRID, font = list(color = INK, size = 12)),
  plot_bgcolor = "white", paper_bgcolor = "white", ...) |> config(displaylogo = FALSE)

# Horizontal share bars. df: label, pct, hover (rows top to bottom)
pl_bars <- function(df, p, xlab, colors = DARK) {
  df$y <- factor(df$label, levels = rev(df$label))
  plot_ly(df, y = ~y, x = ~pct, type = "bar", orientation = "h", marker = list(color = rep_len(colors, nrow(df))),
          text = ~paste0(round(pct), "%"), textposition = "outside", cliponaxis = FALSE, textfont = list(color = INK, size = 13),
          hovertext = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text", height = 140 + 55 * nrow(df), width = PLOT_W) |>
    pl_layout(p, showlegend = FALSE, xaxis = list(title = xlab, range = c(0, 112), ticksuffix = "%", gridcolor = GRID, zeroline = FALSE),
              yaxis = list(title = "", automargin = TRUE))
}
# Stacked share bars. d: group (rows top to bottom), cat (factor, stack order), pct, hover; colors named by cat
pl_stack <- function(d, p, xlab, colors) {
  d$y <- factor(d$group, levels = rev(unique(d$group)))
  pl <- plot_ly(height = 400, width = PLOT_W)
  for (cc in levels(d$cat)) { s <- d[d$cat == cc, ]
    pl <- pl |> add_trace(data = s, y = ~y, x = ~pct, type = "bar", orientation = "h", name = cc, marker = list(color = colors[[cc]], line = list(color = "white", width = 2)),
                          text = ~ifelse(pct >= 5, paste0(round(pct), "%"), ""), textposition = "inside", insidetextanchor = "middle",
                          hovertext = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text") }
  pl |> pl_layout(p, barmode = "stack", xaxis = list(title = xlab, range = c(0, 100), ticksuffix = "%", gridcolor = GRID),
                  yaxis = list(title = "", automargin = TRUE), legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.45, traceorder = "normal"))
}
# One square per participant. w: x, y, group (factor), hover; colors in the order of levels(group)
pl_waffle <- function(w, p, colors, annotations = list()) {
  plot_ly(w, x = ~x, y = ~y, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", color = ~group, colors = colors,
          marker = list(symbol = "square", size = 26, line = list(color = "white", width = 1)), hovertext = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text", height = 480, width = PLOT_W) |>
    pl_layout(p, xaxis = list(visible = FALSE), yaxis = list(visible = FALSE, scaleanchor = "x"), annotations = annotations,
              legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.05))
}
# Dumbbell: d has label (rows top to bottom), a, b, hover_a, hover_b
pl_dumbbell <- function(d, p, xlab, name_a, name_b, col_a = LIGHT, col_b = DARK, xrange = NULL) {
  d$y <- factor(d$label, levels = rev(d$label))
  plot_ly(d, height = 190 + 50 * nrow(d), width = PLOT_W) |>
    add_segments(x = ~a, xend = ~b, y = ~y, yend = ~y, line = list(color = BAR, width = 6), hoverinfo = "none", showlegend = FALSE) |>
    add_markers(x = ~a, y = ~y, name = name_a, marker = list(color = col_a, size = 14), hovertext = ~hover_a, hoverinfo = "text") |>
    add_markers(x = ~b, y = ~y, name = name_b, marker = list(color = col_b, size = 14), hovertext = ~hover_b, hoverinfo = "text") |>
    pl_layout(p, xaxis = list(title = xlab, gridcolor = GRID, zeroline = FALSE, range = xrange), yaxis = list(title = "", automargin = TRUE),
              legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.3))
}
```

```{js resize-in-tabs, echo = FALSE}
$(document).on("shown.bs.tab", function() { window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize")); });
```

This report recomputes every number in **Nov 2026 Pulse - AI and trust part 3b: what did AI say back to people?** (and the matching web page, /part3b/) from the same data as the 07 report, and draws a static version of each chart in the Healogix colors. Each chart is saved as a PNG (300 dpi) in `output/`r script_name`/figures/`. The **Check against deck** tab lists each number on the slides next to the value R gets now; any row marked "check" means the slide and the data disagree.

**Hover over any dot, square or bar** to see the numbers and up to `r HOVER_EXAMPLES` example messages from the people in that group (the participant message or AI sentence that best shows the group). The examples are real conversation excerpts, so keep this report internal.

Group splits, the "felt calmer" rule (negative affect fell `r CALMER_CUT`+ points) and the Benjamini-Hochberg correction (across all 16 segments within each outcome) follow 07 exactly.

# Slides {.tabset}

## 3. Big numbers

Slide 3 repeats one number each from slides 4, 5 and 8, in that order, so it shows only this document's own findings. Its numbers are computed in those tabs and checked in the **Check against deck** tab (rows marked slide 3).

## 4. Distress before and after

```{r slide4}
grp_means <- function(group, label_map = NULL) {
  tibble(group = group, pre = dat$na_pre, post = dat$na_post) |> filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(pre), !is.na(post)) |>
    group_by(group) |> summarise(n = n(), pre = mean(pre), post = mean(post), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(group = as.character(group))
}
all_row <- dat |> filter(!is.na(na_pre), !is.na(na_post)) |> summarise(n = n(), pre = mean(na_pre), post = mean(na_post)) |>
  mutate(group = "All participants")
ref <- grp_means(SEGMENTS[["Referred to a professional"]])
urg <- grp_means(SEGMENTS[["Urgent care advice"]])
per <- grp_means(SEGMENTS[["Shared personal details"]])
relabel <- c("Referred to a professional" = "AI referred them to a professional", "No referral" = "AI did not refer them",
             "Mentioned urgent or emergency care" = "AI mentioned urgent care or the ER", "Did not" = "AI did not mention urgent care",
             "Shared personal details" = "They shared their own situation", "General questions only" = "They did not share their own situation")
s4 <- bind_rows(all_row, ref, urg, per) |>
  mutate(label = ifelse(group %in% names(relabel), relabel[group], group),
         label = paste0(label, " (n = ", n, ")"))
s4$label <- factor(s4$label, levels = rev(s4$label))

dk <- tribble(~group, ~deck,
  "All participants", "n = 57, 18.5 to 15.2", "Referred to a professional", "n = 43, 19.7 to 15.6", "No referral", "n = 11, 14.4 to 13.7",
  "Mentioned urgent or emergency care", "n = 19, 20.2 to 15.0", "Did not", "n = 35, 17.8 to 15.4",
  "Shared personal details", "n = 41, 18.7 to 14.4", "General questions only", "n = 7, 20.7 to 20.0")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(dk))) { r <- s4[s4$group == dk$group[i], ]
  check("4", paste("Negative affect:", dk$group[i]), dk$deck[i], paste0("n = ", r$n, ", ", fmt(r$pre), " to ", fmt(r$post))) }
check("4", "Referral vs. no referral: p (BH)", ".02 (.12)", paste0(fmtp(P_NA["Referred to a professional"], 2), " (", fmtp(P_NA_BH["Referred to a professional"], 2), ")"))

long4 <- s4 |> select(label, pre, post) |> pivot_longer(c(pre, post), names_to = "when", values_to = "score") |>
  mutate(when = factor(when, c("pre", "post"), c("Before the chat", "After the chat")))
p4 <- ggplot(s4, aes(y = label)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = pre, xend = post, yend = label), color = BAR, linewidth = 2.5, lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(data = long4, aes(x = score, color = when), size = 6) +
  geom_text(aes(x = pmax(pre, post), label = fmt(pmax(pre, post))), hjust = -0.6, color = MUTED, size = 4) +
  geom_text(aes(x = pmin(pre, post), label = fmt(pmin(pre, post))), hjust = 1.6, color = MUTED, size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Before the chat" = LIGHT, "After the chat" = DARK)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(floor(min(long4$score) / 2) * 2 - 1, ceiling(max(long4$score) / 2) * 2 + 1), breaks = function(l) seq(ceiling(l[1] / 2) * 2, floor(l[2] / 2) * 2, 2)) +
  labs(title = wrap("Distress dropped after the chat, most when the AI pointed people to a professional"),
       subtitle = wrap(paste0("PANAS negative affect (10 items, 10 = none, 50 = extreme)  |  referral vs. no referral: Mann-Whitney p = ",
                              fmtp(P_NA["Referred to a professional"]), " (BH-adjusted ", fmtp(P_NA_BH["Referred to a professional"]),
                              ")  |  people the AI referred started out more distressed"), 110),
       x = "Distress score (lower = calmer)  \u2190 less distressed", y = NULL) +
  theme_hx() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
invisible(save_fig(p4, "slide04_distress-before-after"))
has_na <- !is.na(dat$na_pre) & !is.na(dat$na_post)
seg_ids <- function(seg, g) dat$pid[!is.na(SEGMENTS[[seg]]) & SEGMENTS[[seg]] == g & has_na]
ids4 <- list("All participants" = dat$pid[has_na],
  "Referred to a professional" = seg_ids("Referred to a professional", "Referred to a professional"),
  "No referral" = seg_ids("Referred to a professional", "No referral"),
  "Mentioned urgent or emergency care" = seg_ids("Urgent care advice", "Mentioned urgent or emergency care"),
  "Did not" = seg_ids("Urgent care advice", "Did not"),
  "Shared personal details" = seg_ids("Shared personal details", "Shared personal details"),
  "General questions only" = seg_ids("Shared personal details", "General questions only"))
funs4 <- list("All participants" = list(Participant = first_msg),
  "Referred to a professional" = list(Participant = first_msg, AI = ai_msg("ai_refers_professional")),
  "No referral" = list(Participant = first_msg, AI = ai_msg()),
  "Mentioned urgent or emergency care" = list(Participant = first_msg, AI = ai_msg("ai_urgent_care")),
  "Did not" = list(Participant = first_msg, AI = ai_msg()),
  "Shared personal details" = list(Participant = first_msg), "General questions only" = list(Participant = first_msg))
d4 <- s4 |> mutate(label = as.character(label), a = pre, b = post)
d4$hover_a <- d4$hover_b <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(d4)), function(i) paste0("<b>", htmltools::htmlEscape(d4$label[i]), "</b><br>Distress ",
  fmt(d4$pre[i]), " before, ", fmt(d4$post[i]), " after (change ", fmts(d4$post[i] - d4$pre[i]), ")",
  examples(ids4[[d4$group[i]]], funs4[[d4$group[i]]])), character(1))
pl_dumbbell(d4, p4, "Distress score (lower = calmer)", "Before the chat", "After the chat")
```

## 5. Felt calmer

```{r slide5}
med <- SEGMENTS[["AI recommended a medication"]]
d5 <- tibble(group = med, cat = CALMER) |> filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(cat)) |> mutate(group = droplevels(group))
by5 <- d5 |> group_by(group) |> summarise(n = n(), calm = sum(cat == "Calmer"), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(pct = 100 * calm / n)
g_rec <- by5[by5$group == "AI recommended a medication", ]; g_not <- by5[by5$group == "Did not recommend one", ]
check("5", "Felt calmer: AI recommended a medication", "0% (0 of 11)", paste0(round(g_rec$pct), "% (", g_rec$calm, " of ", g_rec$n, ")"))
check("5", "Felt calmer: AI did not recommend one", "35% (15 of 43)", paste0(round(g_not$pct), "% (", g_not$calm, " of ", g_not$n, ")"))
check("5", "Felt calmer: p (BH)", ".02 (.38)", paste0(fmtp(P_CALMER["AI recommended a medication"], 2), " (", fmtp(P_CALMER_BH["AI recommended a medication"], 2), ")"))

COLS <- 9
w5 <- d5 |> arrange(group, cat) |> group_by(group) |> mutate(i = row_number() - 1, col = i %% COLS, row = i %/% COLS) |> ungroup() |>
  left_join(by5, by = "group") |>
  mutate(panel = factor(paste0(group, "\n", round(pct), "% calmer (n = ", n, ")"),
                        levels = unique(paste0(by5$group, "\n", round(by5$pct), "% calmer (n = ", by5$n, ")"))))
p5 <- ggplot(w5, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = cat)) +
  geom_tile(width = 0.86, height = 0.86) +
  facet_wrap(~panel) + coord_equal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Calmer" = DARK, "About the same" = PALE, "More distressed" = NEG), drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = wrap("No one felt calmer after the AI recommended a medication"),
       subtitle = wrap(paste0("One square per participant  |  calmer = negative affect fell ", CALMER_CUT, "+ points  |  Fisher's exact p = ",
                              fmtp(P_CALMER["AI recommended a medication"]), " (BH-adjusted ", fmtp(P_CALMER_BH["AI recommended a medication"]),
                              ")  |  only ", g_rec$n, " conversations included a recommendation, so read this as a direction"), 110),
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_hx() + theme(axis.text = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                     strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = INK, size = 14))
invisible(save_fig(p5, "slide05_felt-calmer", h = 6.5))
w5p <- tibble(pid = dat$pid, med = med, cat = CALMER, pre = dat$na_pre, post = dat$na_post) |>
  filter(!is.na(med), !is.na(cat)) |> mutate(med = droplevels(med)) |> arrange(med, cat) |> group_by(med) |>
  mutate(i = row_number() - 1, x = i %% COLS + ifelse(as.integer(med) == 2, COLS + 2, 0), y = -(i %/% COLS)) |> ungroup()
w5p$hover <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(w5p)), function(k) {
  id <- w5p$pid[k]; rec <- w5p$med[k] == "AI recommended a medication"
  paste0("<b>pid ", id, "</b> | ", w5p$med[k], "<br>", w5p$cat[k], ": distress ", w5p$pre[k], " before, ", w5p$post[k], " after",
         "<br><br><i>Participant:</i> ", wrap_html(clip(coalesce(first_msg(id), "(no participant message)"))),
         "<br><i>AI:</i> ", wrap_html(clip(coalesce(ai_msg(if (rec) "ai_recommends_med" else NULL)(id), "(no AI text)")))) }, character(1))
w5p$group <- w5p$cat
ann5 <- lapply(levels(w5p$med), function(g) { r <- by5[by5$group == g, ]; off <- if (g == levels(w5p$med)[2]) COLS + 2 else 0
  list(x = off + (COLS - 1) / 2, y = 1.2, xref = "x", yref = "y", showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 13, color = INK),
       text = paste0("<b>", g, "</b><br>", round(r$pct), "% calmer (n = ", r$n, ")")) })
pl_waffle(w5p, p5, c(DARK, PALE, NEG), annotations = ann5)
```

## 6. Each negative feeling

```{r slide6}
ref_g <- SEGMENTS[["Referred to a professional"]]
# Same people as the referral rows on slide 4: a usable, coded chat and a complete negative-affect score before and after.
# (Without this filter a person who skipped one item still counted for the other items, so item ns ran to 44 / 12.)
complete_na <- dat$pid[!is.na(dat$na_change)]
s6 <- panas |> mutate(group = ref_g[match(panas$pid, dat$pid)]) |> filter(!is.na(group), pid %in% complete_na) |>
  select(pid, group, matches(paste0("panas_(pre|post)_(", paste(NA_ITEMS, collapse = "|"), ")$"))) |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("panas_"), names_to = c("wave", "item"), names_pattern = "panas_(pre|post)_(.*)") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = wave, values_from = value) |> filter(!is.na(pre), !is.na(post)) |>
  group_by(group, item) |> summarise(n = n(), change = mean(post - pre), .groups = "drop")
wide6 <- s6 |> select(-n) |> pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = change) |>
  rename(ref = `Referred to a professional`, nor = `No referral`) |> arrange(ref)
n6 <- s6 |> group_by(group) |> summarise(n = max(n))

deck6 <- c(distressed = "-0.74 vs +0.09", nervous = "-0.67 vs -0.36", afraid = "-0.56 vs -0.09", scared = "-0.53 vs 0.00",
           upset = "-0.44 vs 0.00", irritable = "-0.42 vs +0.18", jittery = "-0.23 vs -0.55", ashamed = "-0.21 vs -0.09",
           guilty = "-0.19 vs -0.09", hostile = "-0.12 vs +0.27")
f2 <- function(x) ifelse(round(x, 2) == 0, "0.00", sprintf("%+.2f", x)) |> sub(pattern = "^\\+0\\.00$", replacement = "0.00")
for (it in names(deck6)) { r <- wide6[wide6$item == it, ]
  check("6", paste0("Change in '", it, "': referred vs. not"), sub("^-", "-", deck6[[it]]), paste0(f2(r$ref), " vs ", f2(r$nor))) }
check("6", "Group sizes on the slide footer", "n = 43 / 11",
      paste0("n = ", n6$n[n6$group == "Referred to a professional"], " / ", n6$n[n6$group == "No referral"], " (largest per item)"))

wide6 <- wide6 |> mutate(item = factor(str_to_title(item), levels = rev(str_to_title(item))))
long6 <- wide6 |> pivot_longer(c(ref, nor), names_to = "g", values_to = "change") |>
  mutate(g = factor(g, c("ref", "nor"), c(paste0("AI referred them (n = ", n6$n[n6$group == "Referred to a professional"], ")"),
                                          paste0("AI did not refer them (n = ", n6$n[n6$group == "No referral"], ")"))))
p6 <- ggplot(wide6, aes(y = item)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#9AA3AF", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = ref, xend = nor, yend = item), color = BAR, linewidth = 2.5, lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(data = long6, aes(x = change, color = g), size = 6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(c(DARK, LIGHT), levels(long6$g))) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = range(c(-0.2, 0.2, long6$change)) + c(-0.1, 0.1), breaks = seq(-2, 2, 0.2), labels = function(x) ifelse(x > 0, paste0("+", x), x)) +
  labs(title = wrap(paste0("After a referral, feeling ", paste(tolower(levels(wide6$item))[10:8], collapse = ", "), " dropped the most")),
       subtitle = wrap("Average change in each PANAS negative item (1 to 5 scale, after minus before)  |  left of 0 = felt less  |  descriptive, not tested item by item", 110),
       x = "Average change", y = NULL) +
  theme_hx() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
invisible(save_fig(p6, "slide06_negative-items"))
ref_ids <- dat$pid[ref_g == "Referred to a professional" & !is.na(ref_g) & dat$pid %in% complete_na]
nor_ids <- dat$pid[ref_g == "No referral" & !is.na(ref_g) & dat$pid %in% complete_na]
ex_ref <- examples(ref_ids, list(AI = ai_msg("ai_refers_professional")), "Examples of the referral")
ex_nor <- examples(nor_ids, list(Participant = first_msg, AI = ai_msg()), "Examples from chats without a referral")
d6 <- wide6 |> mutate(label = as.character(item), a = ref, b = nor) |> select(label, a, b)
d6$hover_a <- paste0("<b>Feeling ", tolower(d6$label), "</b><br>AI referred them (n = ", n6$n[n6$group == "Referred to a professional"], "): ",
                     sprintf("%+.2f", d6$a), "<br>Difference from no referral: ", sprintf("%+.2f", d6$a - d6$b), ex_ref)
d6$hover_b <- paste0("<b>Feeling ", tolower(d6$label), "</b><br>AI did not refer them (n = ", n6$n[n6$group == "No referral"], "): ",
                     sprintf("%+.2f", d6$b), ex_nor)
pl_dumbbell(d6, p6, "Average change (1 to 5 scale, after minus before; left of 0 = felt less)",
            paste0("AI referred them (n = ", n6$n[n6$group == "Referred to a professional"], ")"),
            paste0("AI did not refer them (n = ", n6$n[n6$group == "No referral"], ")"), col_a = DARK, col_b = LIGHT)
```

## 7. Messages and positive feelings

```{r slide7}
# Usable health conversations only, so the base matches the other slides (the 07 report keeps everyone with a turn count)
d7 <- dat |> filter(convo_usable == 1, !is.na(n_human_turns), n_human_turns >= 1, !is.na(pa_change)) |>
  mutate(bucket = factor(ifelse(n_human_turns >= 4, "4 or more", as.character(n_human_turns)), levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4 or more")))
by7 <- d7 |> group_by(bucket) |> summarise(n = n(), m = mean(pa_change), .groups = "drop")
ct7 <- safe(suppressWarnings(cor.test(d7$n_human_turns, d7$pa_change, method = "spearman")))
d7_all <- dat |> filter(!is.na(n_human_turns), !is.na(pa_change))
ct7_all <- safe(suppressWarnings(cor.test(d7_all$n_human_turns, d7_all$pa_change, method = "spearman")))

deck7 <- c(`1` = "-0.6 (n = 20)", `2` = "-2.6 (n = 8)", `3` = "-0.3 (n = 9)", `4 or more` = "+3.3 (n = 11)")
for (b in names(deck7)) { r <- by7[by7$bucket == b, ]
  check("7", paste0("Positive affect change: ", b, ifelse(b == "1", " message", " messages")), deck7[[b]],
        if (nrow(r)) paste0(ifelse(round(r$m, 1) == 0, "0.0", sprintf("%+.1f", r$m)), " (n = ", r$n, ")") else "no one") }
check("7", "Spearman rho, p (usable chats, 1+ message)", "rho = .31, p = .03, n = 48",
      paste0("rho = ", sub("^0", "", fmt(ct7$estimate, 2)), ", p = ", fmtp(ct7$p.value, 2), ", n = ", nrow(d7)))
check("7", "For reference: rho in the 07 report (everyone with a turn count)", "(not on slide)",
      paste0("rho = ", fmt(ct7_all$estimate, 2), ", p = ", fmtp(ct7_all$p.value), ", n = ", nrow(d7_all)))

set.seed(3)
p7 <- ggplot(by7, aes(x = bucket, y = m)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#9AA3AF", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = m > 0), width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(data = d7, aes(y = pa_change), width = 0.18, height = 0, color = MUTED, alpha = 0.45, size = 2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(round(m, 1) == 0, "0.0", sprintf("%+.1f", m)), vjust = ifelse(m >= 0, -0.6, 1.6)),
            color = DARK, fontface = "bold", size = 6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = DARK, `FALSE` = LIGHT), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = paste0(levels(by7$bucket), ifelse(levels(by7$bucket) == "1", " message", " messages"),
                                   "\n(n = ", by7$n, ")")) +
  labs(title = wrap("People who kept the conversation going ended up feeling more positive"),
       subtitle = wrap(paste0("Bars = average change in PANAS positive affect (after minus before); dots = each participant  |  Spearman rho = ",
                              fmt(ct7$estimate, 2), ", p = ", fmtp(ct7$p.value), ", n = ", nrow(d7),
                              " who sent at least one message  |  small groups, read as a pattern"), 110),
       x = "Messages the participant sent to the AI", y = "Change in positive affect") +
  theme_hx() + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
invisible(save_fig(p7, "slide07_messages-positive-affect"))
b7 <- by7 |> mutate(bucket = as.character(bucket),
  lab = paste0(ifelse(bucket == "1", "1 message", ifelse(bucket == "4 or more", "4 or more", paste(bucket, "messages"))), "<br>(n = ", n, ")"))
b7$hover <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(b7)), function(i) {
  ids <- d7$pid[as.character(d7$bucket) == b7$bucket[i]]
  paste0("<b>", sub("<br>.*", "", b7$lab[i]), "</b><br>Average change in positive affect: ", sprintf("%+.1f", b7$m[i]),
         "<br>People: ", b7$n[i], " (", sum(d7$pa_change[as.character(d7$bucket) == b7$bucket[i]] > 0), " felt more positive)",
         examples(ids, if (b7$bucket[i] == "1") list(Message = first_msg) else list(`First message` = first_msg, `Last message` = last_msg))) }, character(1))
plot_ly(b7, x = ~lab, y = ~m, type = "bar", marker = list(color = ifelse(b7$m > 0, DARK, LIGHT)), text = ~sprintf("%+.1f", m),
        textposition = "outside", cliponaxis = FALSE, hovertext = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text", height = 500, width = PLOT_W) |>
  pl_layout(p7, showlegend = FALSE, xaxis = list(title = "Messages the participant sent to the AI", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = b7$lab),
            yaxis = list(title = "Change in positive affect", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "#9AA3AF", gridcolor = GRID))
```

## 8. What people recalled

```{r slide8}
recode_e2 <- function(x) { t <- lc(x); factor(case_when(
  t %in% c("5", "6") | str_detect(t, "clearly recommended|strongly urged") ~ "Clear or strong recommendation",
  t %in% c("3", "4") | str_detect(t, "gently suggested|possible actions") ~ "Gentle suggestion or options",
  t %in% c("1", "2") | str_detect(t, "did not recommend|wait it out") ~ "No action or wait it out",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("Clear or strong recommendation", "Gentle suggestion or options", "No action or wait it out")) }
d8 <- tibble(group = bin_lab(dat$ai_refers_professional, "AI referred them", "AI did not refer"),
             cat = recode_e2(coalesce(dat$action_ai_rec_self, dat$action_ai_rec_other))) |> filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(cat))
by8 <- d8 |> count(group, cat, .drop = FALSE) |> group_by(group) |> mutate(N = sum(n), pct = 100 * n / N) |> ungroup()
p8_val <- safe(fisher.test(table(d8$group, d8$cat == "Clear or strong recommendation"))$p.value) %||% NA_real_

cnt <- function(g) { r <- by8[by8$group == g, ]; paste0(r$n[1], " of ", r$N[1], " (", round(r$pct[1]), "%), ", r$n[2], ", ", r$n[3]) }
check("8", "Referred: clear or strong / gentle / none", "25 of 43 (58%), 14, 4", cnt("AI referred them"))
check("8", "Not referred: clear or strong / gentle / none", "1 of 11 (9%), 8, 2", cnt("AI did not refer"))
check("8", "Fisher's exact p (clear or strong vs. not)", ".005", fmtp(p8_val))

by8 <- by8 |> mutate(group = factor(paste0(group, "\n(n = ", N, ")"), levels = rev(unique(paste0(by8$group, "\n(n = ", by8$N, ")")))),
                     cat = factor(cat, levels = rev(levels(d8$cat))))
p8 <- ggplot(by8, aes(x = pct, y = group, fill = cat)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(pct >= 8, paste0(round(pct), "%"), ""),
                color = cat == "Clear or strong recommendation"),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4.3, lineheight = 0.9, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Clear or strong recommendation" = DARK, "Gentle suggestion or options" = PALE, "No action or wait it out" = NEG),
                    breaks = levels(d8$cat)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = INK), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = wrap("When the AI tells people to see someone, they remember"),
       subtitle = wrap(paste0("What participants recalled the AI recommending (survey item E2)  |  referral coded from the AI's own text  |  Fisher's exact p = ",
                              fmtp(p8_val)), 110),
       x = "% of participants in each group", y = NULL) +
  theme_hx() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
invisible(save_fig(p8, "slide08_recall", h = 6))
d8p <- tibble(pid = dat$pid, group = bin_lab(dat$ai_refers_professional, "AI referred them", "AI did not refer"),
              cat = recode_e2(coalesce(dat$action_ai_rec_self, dat$action_ai_rec_other))) |> filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(cat))
N8 <- table(d8p$group)
d8h <- d8p |> count(group, cat, .drop = FALSE) |>
  mutate(N = as.integer(N8[as.character(group)]), pct = 100 * n / N, grp = paste0(group, " (n = ", N, ")"))
d8h$hover <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(d8h)), function(i) {
  ids <- d8p$pid[d8p$group == d8h$group[i] & d8p$cat == d8h$cat[i]]
  funs <- if (d8h$group[i] == "AI referred them") list(AI = ai_msg("ai_refers_professional")) else list(Participant = first_msg, AI = ai_msg())
  hover_share(paste0(d8h$group[i], ': recalled "', tolower(d8h$cat[i]), '"'), d8h$pct[i], d8h$n[i], d8h$N[i], examples(ids, funs)) }, character(1))
pl_stack(d8h |> transmute(group = grp, cat, pct, hover), p8, "% of participants in each group",
         c("Clear or strong recommendation" = DARK, "Gentle suggestion or options" = PALE, "No action or wait it out" = NEG))
```

```{r slide9}
all_n <- dat |> filter(!is.na(na_pre), !is.na(na_post))
pa_n  <- dat |> filter(!is.na(pa_pre), !is.na(pa_post))
check("9", "Negative affect, everyone", "18.5 to 15.2", paste0(fmt(mean(all_n$na_pre)), " to ", fmt(mean(all_n$na_post))))
check("9", "Positive affect, everyone (\"stayed flat\")", "26.7 to 26.8", paste0(fmt(mean(pa_n$pa_pre)), " to ", fmt(mean(pa_n$pa_post))))
check("9", "AI referrals reached the most distressed: before-chat distress, referred vs. not", "19.7 vs. 14.4",
      paste0(fmt(s4$pre[s4$group == "Referred to a professional"]), " vs. ", fmt(s4$pre[s4$group == "No referral"])))
# Slide 3 big numbers (one each from slides 4, 5 and 8)

check("3", "Felt calmer: medication recommended vs. everyone else", "0% vs. 35%", paste0(round(g_rec$pct), "% vs. ", round(g_not$pct), "%"))

      paste0(round(by8$pct[grepl("^AI referred", by8$group) & by8$cat == "Clear or strong recommendation"]), "% vs. ",
             round(by8$pct[grepl("^AI did not", by8$group) & by8$cat == "Clear or strong recommendation"]), "%"))
check("9", "Change for 4 or more messages (\"about 3 points\")", "+3", sprintf("%+.0f", by7$m[by7$bucket == "4 or more"]))
```

## Check against deck

```{r check}
check_tbl <- bind_rows(CHECK) |>
  mutate(Match = ifelse(Deck == "(not on slide)", "info",
                        ifelse(gsub("[^0-9.+-]", "", gsub("0\\.", ".", Deck)) == gsub("[^0-9.+-]", "", gsub("0\\.", ".", R)), "yes", "check"))) |>
  select(Slide, Measure, Deck, R, Match)
openxlsx::write.xlsx(list(deck_check = check_tbl), file.path(out_dir, "deck-number-check.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
n_off <- sum(check_tbl$Match == "check")
cat(if (n_off == 0) "Every number on the slides matches the data.\n\n" else
  paste0("**", n_off, " number(s) differ from the slides.** These rows are marked \"check\". Update the slide, or look at what changed in the data.\n\n"))
cat(id_note, "\n\n")
kable(check_tbl, align = "llllc")
```

The "Match" column compares the digits only, so formatting differences (for example ".02" vs. "0.02") do not count as a mismatch. This table is also saved as `deck-number-check.xlsx` in the output folder.

## Numbers for the web page

The web page (/part3b/) is built from `part3b_summary.json`, written here to the output folder. It holds group averages and counts only: no pids and no one person's scores. Copy it into the repo at `data/public/part3b_summary.json`, then run `python build/build_part3b.py`.

```{r export-web}
lab_n <- function(g, n) paste0(g, " (n = ", n, ")")
pairs <- function(d) lapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) list(lab_n(d$group[i], d$n[i]), c(d$pre[i], d$post[i])))
item_vals <- function(g) { r <- s6[s6$group == g, ]; list(g, unname(r$change), r$item) }
cnt_list <- function(tab, groups) { o <- list(); for (gi in seq_along(groups)) for (cc in levels(tab$cat)) {
  v <- tab$n[tab$group == groups[gi] & tab$cat == cc]; if (length(v) && v > 0) o[[paste0(gi, "|", cc)]] <- v }; o }
d5x <- d5 |> count(group, cat, .drop = FALSE)
d8x <- tibble(group = bin_lab(dat$ai_refers_professional, "AI referred to a professional", "No referral"),
              cat = recode_e2(coalesce(dat$action_ai_rec_self, dat$action_ai_rec_other))) |>
  filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(cat)) |> count(group, cat, .drop = FALSE)
web <- list(
  ref_na  = pairs(ref), urg_na = pairs(urg), pers_na = pairs(per),
  ref_items = list(item_vals("Referred to a professional"), item_vals("No referral")),
  ref_items_n = list(ref = n6$n[n6$group == "Referred to a professional"], nor = n6$n[n6$group == "No referral"]),
  msg_buckets = lapply(seq_len(nrow(by7)), function(i) { b <- d7$pa_change[d7$bucket == by7$bucket[i]]
    list(bucket = as.character(by7$bucket[i]), n = by7$n[i], mean = by7$m[i], n_more_positive = sum(b > 0)) }),
  msg_test = list(rho = unname(ct7$estimate), p = ct7$p.value, n = nrow(d7)),
  recall = list(cnt_list(d8x, levels(d8x$group)), levels(d8x$group)),
  calm_med = list(cnt_list(d5x, levels(d5x$group)), levels(d5x$group)),
  na_all_means = list(pre = mean(all_n$na_pre), post = mean(all_n$na_post), n = nrow(all_n)),
  pa_all_means = list(pre = mean(pa_n$pa_pre), post = mean(pa_n$pa_post), n = nrow(pa_n)))
jsonlite::write_json(web, file.path(out_dir, "part3b_summary.json"), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 10, pretty = TRUE)
cat("Wrote", file.path(out_dir, "part3b_summary.json"), "\n")
```
